pilot.name: Treasure Valley research pilot
pilot.researcher: Claude Code session acting for the owner. Research and drafts only: no business was contacted, no form was submitted to a business, nothing was sent.

labels.observed: Seen on a cited page or official record on the research date.
labels.inferred: Follows from observed facts; not stated by the business.
labels.hypothesis: A possible problem. Unconfirmed until the business confirms it or credible evidence establishes it.

scoring.fit: 0-3. 3 = owner-led firm in the core segment (HVAC, plumbing, electrical) that a list-priced offer fits; 2 = adjacent segment or size unclear; 1 = no ready offer or likely too small; 0 = poor fit.
scoring.evidence: 0-3. 3 = several observed signals of a lead-response or operations gap; 2 = one clear signal; 1 = weak or indirect signals; 0 = the problem looks solved.
scoring.reach: 0-3. 3 = named decision-maker plus a direct business email or phone; 2 = named decision-maker with a general channel, or a direct email without a name; 1 = general channel only; 0 = none.
scoring.priority: Contact first >= 12; Second wave 6-11; Hold = fits a segment but evidence is weak; Discovery only = possible need, no offer yet; Skip = poor fit; Partner = better approached as a referral partner than as a customer.

pilot.draftFooter: Every draft ends with: [Your name] · [phone] · [ForgeX postal address] · Reply "no thanks" and I won't write again. (CAN-SPAM: postal address, clear identity, opt-out honored within 10 business days.)
notChecked: Idaho Secretary of State entity records
Census County Business Patterns counts (the API now requires a key; signing up for one needs the owner)
Review sites, LinkedIn, Google Maps and job boards (excluded by policy)
